description: Create a new voice agent by describing it in plain English instead of filling in name/personality/instructions/voice yourself. Requires the OWNER or ADMIN role. Response always includes the new agentId, plus either the generated agent config, or needsFollowUp: true with a follow-up question if the prompt was too thin to act on — call generate_voice_agent_config again on that agentId with more detail (or manualInstructions) when that happens.

manualInstructions.description: Skip generation and use this as the agent's instructions verbatim.

name.description: Agent name. Defaults to one derived from the prompt if omitted.

prompt.description: Plain-English description of the agent to build, e.g. "a friendly dental clinic receptionist that books appointments and answers insurance questions".

name: create_voice_agent_from_prompt

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API

title: Create Voice Agent From Prompt
